# A01-S04: Political leader

Correspondence extract. [████] marks redaction; […] marks omission.

[…]

Thanks for a really good and thorough update from your side :-) I’m gradually beginning to understand where the organization is going, and become clear about what I can offer within the new setup.

I would very much like to talk on Teams, and I’m flexible right now. So just send a date proposal!

[████] We believe it could create the (long-awaited) public debate about 18 SDG. From conferences I also know all the crazy transhumanists who have started similar parties in other countries, so there are some resources to draw on. It would be a wild experiment to get the political structures here to react (they believe, after all, that questions about AI, humans, and technology are apolitical, and can be handled by various agencies). I can write a proposal if you want, but let’s talk a bit broader first.
